name: BlastRadius Change-Safety Agent
description: Predicts the cross-domain blast radius of firmware and configuration changes on HPE compute, network and virtualization, verifies every planner claim against tool evidence (Trust Score), and executes approved changes in canary waves with automatic rollback.

provider.organization: HPE Agentic AI Hackathon India 2026 team (PoC)

skills.name: Assess change blast radius
skills.description: Natural-language change intent in; dependency graph, per-asset risk, staged wave plan, Trust Score and go/no-go card out. Read-only.
examples: Upgrade iLO 6 and System ROM on PROD-BLR-07 and the ToR switch pair to the latest baseline on Saturday

skills.name: Execute approved change in canary waves
skills.description: Runs a human-approved plan wave by wave with pre/during/post golden-signal checks and automatic rollback. Requires signed approvals.

skills.name: Verify agent claims
skills.description: Splits another agent's rationale into atomic claims and labels each Supported / Contradicted / Unverifiable against MCP tool evidence.
